name: Sanford Health Sioux Falls Volunteer Program (Ages 16 and Up)
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital and clinics. Jobs include escort, greeter, gift shop helper and aide. Units include rehab and cardiology. One is the Children's Hospital.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 16 years old. Some jobs need you to be 18 or 19. The page lists more than 20 jobs open to 16 year olds.
duration: A weekly or biweekly shift of three to four hours for medical center, clinic and wellness center volunteers.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application. Then do a phone interview and a criminal background check. You also need an updated vaccination record. Next come a one hour orientation with a health assessment. Then come a department orientation. Call Volunteer Services. The number is (605) 333-6374.
notes: No special program for 14 and 15 year olds was found on this page. Some roles need a vaccination record and a background check, so start early.
